text:
maggie: hey team — main CI is red on e2e-serve-tests since the runtime-linker bump landed (sha: d4f5a2b). Last green: 1791232000 (commit abcdef1). Failing on linux-x86 and macOS. Anyone available to bisect? cc @jordan @ryan

ci-bot: CI job failed: https://ci.redwood/proj/742/job/8912 — test log: 'segfault in dlopen...'\njob id: 8912

jordan: i can take a look in ~30m. any repro locally?

maggie: i tried `./run_e2e --filter serve` in docker, reproduces with the linker bump image. stacktrace snippet:
```
#0  0x00007f... in dlopen
#1  0x000055... in runtime_init
```
Not sure if it's a build flag or a runtime path.

alex: could be rpath change from the linker. PR was #5123 by @buildbot. Range to bisect: commit abcdef1..d4f5a2b (approx 35 commits).

ryan: recommend `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad` then mark d4f5a2b bad and abcdef1 good. For CI reproducer use:
```
# run bisect script
./infra/tools/ci_bisect.sh --job e2e-serve --replicate 2
```

jordan: on it. i'll run bisection against CI images, will post updates. if it narrows to PR, we can revert quickly.

anya: FYI if bisect hits build system churn, try `make clean && ninja -C out` between steps. Also add `--keep-images` to avoid pulling new images every run.

jordan: first round: narrowed to 8 commits. reproduces on commit 3a7b9f (introduces ELF RPATH patch). digging

maggie: nice. if 3a7b9f is culprit we should revert that patch on main and cut a hotfix to dedicated pools. @ops, can you hold off deploys for main for 30m?

ryan: ops pinged. hold placed.

jordan: confirmed: 3a7b9f causes dlopen segfault on our runtime image. PR number 5178 changes RPATH handling. bisect log:
```
3a7b9f bad
...
```

maggie: ok plan: jordan, open revert PR for 3a7b9f and link bisect log. I'll request urgent review from @alex and @ryan. If tests pass on CI after revert, we merge and roll forward.

jordan: created revert PR: https://gh.redwood/revert/5181 — running CI now.

ci-bot: Revert PR CI started: https://ci.redwood/proj/742/job/8921

alex: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. great triage.
